summary: Rabbi Hidary examines Gemara Arakhin 11, focusing on the instruments and musical service in the Bet HaMikdash. He explores whether music is an essential requirement for sacrifices, the sources in the Torah for the Levites' singing, and whether voluntary offerings require musical accompaniment. He also discusses the prohibitions and rules regarding Levites changing their assigned duties between singing and gatekeeping.
